[SWS_CM_11135] Creating a DDS DataReaderListener for field subscription
⌈
The
DDS implementation shall define a DataReaderListener class to handle field noti-
fications when a new sample is received and/or the matched status of the subscription
changes following the instructions specified in [SWS_CM_11020].
The DataReaderListener class shall specify that the samples to be handled are of
the Topic data type specified in [SWS_CM_11131].
⌋
